message.content:
Below is an overview of **Canadian public‑holiday “long weekends”** that occurred during 2023.  
I’ve grouped the entries by *federal* holidays (which apply everywhere) first, then added the most common *provincial* holidays that created long weekends in at least one jurisdiction.  

> ⚠️ **Note:**  
> • A “long weekend” usually means a statutory holiday that falls on a Monday or a Friday, thereby extending the normal Saturday–Sunday break.  
> • Provincial holidays vary—some provinces share the same dates while others do not.  
> • Where a holiday fell on a weekend, the government normally observes it on the nearest weekday (e.g., Canada Day 2023 was celebrated on Monday Jul 3).

---

### Federal Holidays Creating Long Weekends (All Provinces)

| Holiday | Date 2023 | Observed On (if needed) | Resulting Long Weekend |
|---------|-----------|--------------------------|------------------------|
| **Victoria Day** | Monday 5 May 2023 | — | Fri 28 Apr → Mon 5 May |
| **Canada Day**   | Saturday 1 Jul 2023 | Monday 3 Jul | Sat 1 Jul → Mon 3 Jul |
| **Labour Day**   | Monday 4 Sep 2023 | — | Fri 31 Aug → Mon 4 Sep |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday 9 Oct 2023 | — | Fri 6 Oct → Mon 9 Oct |

*(Other federal holidays—New Year’s, Good Friday, Remembrance Day, Christmas, Boxing Day—did not fall on a Monday/Fri in 2023, so they did not generate a natural long weekend.)*

---

### Common Provincial Holidays Generating Long Weekends

| Province / Territory | Holiday | Date 2023 | Observed On (if needed) | Long Weekend |
|-----------------------|---------|-----------|--------------------------|--------------|
| **Family Day** *(BC, AB, SK, MB)* | Monday 20 Feb 2023 | — | Fri 16 Feb → Mon 20 Feb |
| **St. Patrick’s Day** *(NB, NL, PEI)* | Monday 18 Mar 2023 | — | Fri 14 Mar → Mon 18 Mar |
| **Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day** *(QC)* | Friday 24 Jun 2023 | — | Fri 24 Jun → Sun 26 Jun |
| **Civic Holiday** *(most provinces except QC, NB, NS, PEI)* | First Monday in August (8 Aug 2023) | — | Fri 5 Aug → Mon 8 Aug |
| **National Indigenous Peoples Day** *(AB, BC, MB, ON, SK, YT)* | Monday 21 June 2023 | — | Fri 18 Jun → Mon 21 Jun |
| **Remembrance Day** *(many provinces observe on Thurs Nov 11)* | Thursday 11 Nov 2023 | — | Thu 11 Nov → Sat 13 Nov (often taken as part of a longer break) |
| **Easter Monday** *(only a few provinces: e.g., Nunavut, Yukon, Northwest Territories)* | Monday 10 April 2023 | — | Fri 7 Apr → Mon 10 Apr |

> 📌 **Tip for App Integration**  
> Store each entry as `{name, originalDate, observedDate?, longWeekendStart, longWeekendEnd}`. This allows your UI to highlight the full span of the break even when the holiday itself lands on a weekend.

---

#### Quick Reference List (by month)

| Month | Long‑weekend holidays (any province) |
|------|-------------------------------------|
| January | None |
| February | Family Day (BC, AB, SK, MB) – Feb 20 |
| March | St. Patricks’ Day (NB, NL, PEI) – Mar 18 |
| April | Victoria Day – May 22; Easter Monday (few territories) – Apr 10 |
| May | Victoria Day – May 22 |
| June | National Indigenous Peoples Day – Jun 21; Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day (QC) – Jun 24 |
| July | Canada Day – Jul 1 (obs Jul 3) |
| August | Civic Holiday – Aug 8 |
| September | Labour Day – Sep 4 |
| October | Thanksgiving – Oct 9 |
| November | Remembrance Day – Nov 11 (optional extension) |
| December | None (except optional personal extensions around Xmas) |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like more granular details—for example, how specific provinces handle observances—or if you’re looking for a programmatic way to pull this data via API!
